title: Require Service Database Topology
forbids: an open service database interior; database ownership under a module or embedded API service; missing migration or store ownership; malformed optional physical-schema leaves; or generated, memory, repository, session, persistence, helper, index, provider, role-suffixed, and alternate source shapes
why: A database is an optional service-owned persistence boundary. Requiring closed migrations and stores keeps physical evolution and persistence behavior at the service root. A separately closed schema directory is optional because only some database technologies need distinct physical mappings. Role-neutral residual filenames leave migration, schema, and store meaning with their containing directories.
remediate: Keep an optional standalone database at services/<service>/src/service/db with required migrations/*.sql and stores/*.ts. Add only schema/*.ts when the selected database technology needs separate physical mappings. Name schema and store leaves by their residual domain noun rather than repeating schema, store, repository, reader, writer, session, persistence, provider, generated, helper, or index roles. Move external acquisition to a resource/provider and project store capabilities through direct named service-root middleware.
message: Service databases must retain closed migration and store ownership, with only an optional closed physical-schema boundary.
